notes.title: Ver1.2 Released: Fixed the issue of can not cancel the "TopMost" mode
notes.notes:
Ver1.2 Fixed the issue of can not cancel the "TopMost" mode: Just uncheck the "TopMost" option at Tray Icon PopupMenu (Screen Bottom-Right corner,near by your WIFI icon) to cancel the "TopMost" mode.
